algorithm_title: Find the sum of all even numbers in a list
evidence_summary: This suite provides limited behavioural evidence using one predefined common behavioural test, with covered normal-path behaviour. List is fixed; empty/no-even/all-even variants are not externally injectable.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the predefined common behavioural test, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: normal path.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as agreement for the specific exercised scenario or scenarios, not as strong evidence of general behavioural equivalence.
coverage_limitations: List is fixed; empty/no-even/all-even variants are not externally injectable.
